verdict.rationale: A managed database service could plausibly ship an in-console AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence only covers external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, and others) connecting over MCP, agent-drivable CHKit commands, and isolated compute or branches for agents. None of that is a built-in assistant you delegate tasks to inside the product, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
